integrity: The all-n structural bijection and cyclic-gap proof imply the formulas; independent brute-force and dynamic-program checks are corroborative finite experiments only.
scientific_limitations: Only finite simple circular ladders C_n Cartesian K_2 for n>=3, labelled vertex open packings. Not Möbius ladders or arbitrary prisms. No independent validation or established global priority.
title: Complete open-packing polynomial and six-residue maximum census of circular ladders
